title: Sociology, B.A. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Historical catalog-year build (2025-2026 archived bulletin edition), verified against the real archived page at the source URL above (curl'd raw HTML, cross-checked against the live 2026 page's WebFetch summary to avoid the known confabulation trap -- no discrepancy found). Program Requirements are byte-for-byte identical to SOCBA-2026.json's: same 7 prescribed courses (CAS 283, SOC 1, SOC 207, SOC 400W, SOC 405, SOC 470, STAT 200), same 'Select 15 credits in sociology, at least 9 at the 400 level' supporting bucket, same minimum-123... correction: this edition's own Program Requirements tab already states the same credit-distribution table as 2026 (General Education 45 / Electives 20 / B.A. Degree Requirements 24 / Requirements for the Major 38). The Suggested Academic Plan tab for this edition already shows the University Park total as 126 credits and the Commonwealth Campuses total as 124.5 credits -- both match 2026.json exactly, including the explicit 'LA 83' (1.5cr, First Year Fall) and 'LA 283' (1.5cr, Second Year Spring, modeled here per 2026.json's own convention as the generic 'Second-Year Liberal Arts Seminar' slot since LA 283 is the same unconfirmed code flagged in 2026.json's notes) lines -- i.e. this LA-seminar addition to the flowchart is NOT new to the 2026 edition, it was already present in 2025-2026. (By contrast, the 2022-2024 archived editions of this same page do NOT have these lines -- see SOCBA-2022/2023/2024.json's notes for that real, confirmed year-over-year difference; 123 credits total in those editions vs. 126 here.) SOC/STAT/CAS course descriptions (bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2025-2026/university-course-descriptions/undergraduate/{soc,stat}/) were also spot-checked for this edition: STAT 200's prerequisite is still the literal 'Placement into MATH 21 or higher' (same as 2022-2026, so this plan keeps 2026.json's MATH 3 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 21 chain fix unchanged), and SOC 207/405/470/400W prerequisites are unchanged from 2026 (SOC 207: 3cr in SOC; SOC 405: 3cr in SOC; SOC 470: SOC 207; SOC 400W: SOC 470) -- since this app's soc_catalog.json/math_catalog data is a single shared catalog file used by every catalog year of this major (not versioned per year), the additional AND-prereq sequencing fixes 2026.json's notes describe (SOC 470 also needs STAT 200; SOC 400W also needs SOC 405, both from the bulletin's own program-requirements PDF footnote) already apply here for free and were re-verified to still be real for this edition, not just assumed. No course-code, credit-count, or sequencing differences found for this year -- this file is a faithful mirror of SOCBA-2026.json with only catalog_year/source updated.
